## Haskell fix handoff for external work

External Haskell documentation follow-up: 2026-10-20 14:55 CEST.
Source inspection found a possible overclaim in the new Typing.hs size-order
paragraph and cfta-generator README: "Binders generators already have
size-major ranks". fromTypingRules uses fromConstructorAutomaton, whose
route depends on actual graph cycles. An acyclic Binders grammar can use
finite constructor order. Candidate: Payload = P Payload | Z and T = A Payload | B Int, with only
rules A(value(P(P Z))) and B(value0), bound Binders0. Both roots have arity1.
The larger A term can precede the B term by finite constructor order. This
valid external-field candidate did not reach rank output in the isolated
cached-dependency reproduction. Seven capped attempts retained compiler and
linker failures; the final executable aborted with exit134 and
"*** stack smashing detected ***". No fresh package build was run. This is
a verification blocker, not evidence of a production runtime defect. Verify
the candidate with a fresh matching toolchain before requesting a repair.
If confirmed, qualify the statement
by the actual cyclic route and retain the upToSize advice for acyclic imports.
No production Haskell file is changed locally. Keep this follow-up separate
from confirmed runtime defects and from the older repair registry below.

# Completed source writer routes and original capture slots

The proof checkpoint is `b6fa22f73`. The verified start is `0197b0001`.
Main remains `9769fe3e9`. The ff-only refresh imports no change.

SourceCurrentCompletedBuildRootedWriters.Written keeps one actual Publication.
That same event supplies its original Reached source route, exact key and
complete candidate payload, actual first-write absence, issued prefix,
three callback intervals, and final growth and issued suffix. The rooted
route is not inferred from arbitrary issued Path or physical heap growth.

build_writer_or_prior consumes an actual completed build and initial lexical
Context. Every selected final Mu cell is either the identical full initial
cell or has a Written receipt rooted in that actual source call. The initial
alternative retains the full selected entry, body, depth and ordinary value.
It cannot be reduced to key presence. build_writer adds the explicit absence
of all initial Mu records and eliminates that alternative. A closed actual
build from empty derives its Context and absence from existing empty facts.
No desired rooted writer is assumed by either producer.

A private source/list/edge induction constructs an issued path whose actual
publication subtrees retain Reached. Node and union calls follow the actual
ordered builds and heap effects. Each binder callback adds its actual
Crossing. Depth, ordinary, reservation, raw body and completion remain in
their actual order. Writer selection follows the actual keepFirst result.
If an earlier callback has already written the selected cell, its actual
path supplies the retained event. The result does not identify that event
with the current callback. Existential source-writer uniqueness is unclaimed.

SourceCurrentSourceCaptureOriginalSlots.original_slot consumes a rooted
source Path, exact captured-slot lookup and exact structural RowAt. It
returns the originalSlot with currentSlot = crossings.length + originalSlot
and the same original-input lookup. Path.inputs supplies the exact prefix
of literal callback references. None can contain RowAt. The proof uses
indexed list recursion, without weakening lookup to list membership.
empty_initial excludes such a row-bearing capture when original inputs are
empty. These are conditional Path laws; the lookup theorem does not itself
produce an original source path for an arbitrary captured value.

The completed-writer producer now supplies the previously missing original
source route within one actual construction. Later native reconstruction
can use leaves.map(input replacement) as its initial captures. These include
whole closed values and self replacements. Its starting heap can also contain
prior Mu records. Their earlier source ancestry is a separate obligation.
The empty-original-input result does not apply to those nonempty captures.
No original global syntax decrease or global renewal bound follows yet.

and concrete Haskell refinement remain open. Conditional root-language and

captured reader. A physical rooted route supplies no transport of that history.

Two constructed declarations pass complete proof and standard-axiom checks.
The Mu example runs one closed union of two different smart binder sources.
The first constructs a used Mu; the second returns that same Mu at the same
heap. The full root returns that payload and derives its rooted writer from
empty facts. The witness keeps the same selected event's Reached, exact key,
full candidate, first-write absence, issued paths and final retention. It
builds the older issued Written receipt from those same fields. The warm
call retains the explicit prior-cell-or-rooted-writer alternative and also
proves the initial selected cell exists. It does not choose a new-writer arm
or identify the event syntax with either source. Strict1 is empty; Full1 passes.

The capture example first builds an available leaf. An actual Depth callback
with that leaf as an original capture returns it from current slot1. The
source Path has one crossing and original slot0. Its initial Context comes
from the actual leaf build. Its inline generic source is byte-identical to
the official capture module; it does not independently import that installed
module. The official module has its own separate strict, canonical and full
checks. The fixture's strict1 is empty and Full1 passes. This is one actual
callback, not a claim that every enclosing binder completes. The earlier
combined generic/example attempts remain successful and unselected.

exact language.

explicit. General termination and Haskell correspondence remain open.
